summary: Corrected W3 Index Lifecycle and Exact-Threshold Baseline handoff: DT-05, DT-16, and DT-17 are scoped-passed evidence only. W3 is not accepted and must remain blocked until TS-09 adapter generation/persistence passes through runEmbeddingProviderAdapterLifecycle.js, proving productionGraphRagRuntime.generateAffectedEmbeddings() exposes Node runtime, no required Neo4j GenAI Plugin, provider-adapter generation, parameterized persistence evidence, and non-Aligned partial failure behavior.
notes: Selected viewpoint frame: Implementation and Migration Viewpoint for W3 acceptance status and sequencing; Technology Usage Viewpoint for adapter/generation/vector-projection dependencies; Requirements Realization Viewpoint for TS-09 as a blocking release gate.

Affected view bindings: grag-index-consistency remains an Application Usage Viewpoint instance for query/index availability; grag-embedding-generation-usage remains a Technology Usage Viewpoint instance and now explicitly binds TS-09 adapter generation/persistence proof as a blocking W3 concern.
Corrected acceptance decision: W3 is not accepted while TS-09 is pending or failing. DT-05, DT-16, and DT-17 may remain scoped-passed evidence, but they do not complete W3 without TS-09.

Coverage proof: grag-seed-retrieval functionalPoint.DT-05-threshold-all-correctness -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-05; grag-semantic-index functionalPoint.DT-16-versioned-vector-baseline -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-16-SemanticIndex; grag-index-lifecycle functionalPoint.DT-16-all-mutation-version-advance -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-16; grag-alignment-constraint functionalPoint.DT-17-unaligned-semantic-rejection -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-17; grag-embedding-provider-adapter functionalPoint.TS-09-adapter-generation -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-09-EmbeddingProviderAdapter; grag-embedding-generation functionalPoint.TS-09-affected-record-generation -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-09-EmbeddingGeneration.

TS-09 blocking evidence: runEmbeddingProviderAdapterLifecycle.js exits 1 with TS09_NODE_ADAPTER_REQUIRED because generateAffectedEmbeddings() does not expose required outcome-level runtime, neo4jGenAiPluginRequired, and adapter generation/persistence evidence.

Downstream ImplementationDesign must regenerate an implementation-to-coding handoff that treats tests/explicit/entries/runEmbeddingProviderAdapterLifecycle.js as in-scope blocking TS-09 work, not out-of-scope frozen evidence.

Human approval evidence: the 2026-07-25 feedback explicitly states TS-09 blocks W3 acceptance; schema-compliant acceptanceApproval.* attributes were recorded in SystemArchitecture.json because testcase and handoff schemas do not allow approvedByHuman fields.
